SYNTHETIC TEST JOB DESCRIPTION — Backend API Engineer
Company: Example Backend Labs (fictional)
Location: Boston / Remote, United States

Responsibilities and selection priorities
Build TypeScript and Node.js REST API services backed by PostgreSQL and Redis. Improve query plans, caching and p95 latency. Ship Docker services on AWS using GitHub Actions CI/CD, integration tests and OpenTelemetry. This is an early-career position; do not require previous leadership.

Required qualifications
- TypeScript
- Node.js
- REST API
- PostgreSQL
- Redis
- Docker
- integration tests

Preferred, not mandatory
- Kafka

Applications are assessed on demonstrated work. Candidates may apply without preferred tools. Do not claim skills you have not used.
